_meta.note: Payload capacity in kilograms including the 15% margin rule applied by the engine.

classes.large: can reach every orbit in orbits.json

launchers.name: Electron
launchers.blurb: Cheap dedicated ride for a small satellite.
launchers.tradeoff: 200 kg ceiling — a medium bus alone will not fit.

launchers.name: Falcon 9 Rideshare (SSO)
launchers.tradeoff: You do not choose the launch date, and you cannot pick MEO or GEO.

launchers.name: Falcon 9 Dedicated
launchers.blurb: You pick the date and the orbit.
launchers.tradeoff: 67M is 1/3 of a typical mission budget.

launchers.name: Ariane 6
launchers.blurb: Heavy lift with excellent GEO performance.
launchers.tradeoff: 18-month lead time: fine for planning, fatal for a 1-year scenario.

launchers.name: Falcon Heavy
launchers.blurb: For telescopes and anything absurdly heavy.
launchers.tradeoff: 150M before a single instrument is bought.
